method: Author adjudication by reading each method pair (full code semantics: variable roles, wrapper chains, exception structure, allocation sources). Independent of ROTA's allocation-text score. Each case: does ROTA's forward map agree with the semantic correspondence a human reads from the code?
sample: 58 ambiguous (multi-obligation, non-name-forced) cases, hardest-first (symbol set differs across versions or resource counts differ), drawn from the 523 ambiguous cases with a fixed seed.

summary.note: No case pairs two semantically unrelated resources. 'judgment_consistent' cases are try-with-resources discharges (the obligation leaves the tracked set, so there is no patched obligation to match) or renames across a type change; ROTA resolves each consistently with the code. The sample skews toward symbol-preserving multi-resource cases; pure disjoint-symbol renames are measured separately by the allocation-text reference (40/48 = 0.833).
